note: Layer order: what beats what at runtime. A question about behaviour enters at a layer and walks up; the first layer that already answered is the answer.

layers.name: defaults
layers.description: Hardcoded defaults in the Python source (openspan.py, modules under win/)
layers.note: No single file — defaults are inline in the code. Lowest priority.

layers.name: config
layers.note: Machine-specific settings: VM name, radio instance IDs, display layout.

layers.name: settings
layers.note: Behavioural preferences: hotkeys, tiling rules, audio balance.

layers.name: modules
layers.note: Module-level overrides written by the settings UI or by modules themselves.

layers.name: runtime
layers.note: Current running state: active displays, connected devices, VM status. Never persisted across restarts. Highest priority — this is what IS, not what should be.
